Container.Name: TaleArr
Container.Overview: TaleArr is an ebook and audiobook collection manager for Usenet and BitTorrent users, a drop-in fork of Chaptarr (itself a Readarr fork). It monitors authors and books, grabs the right edition and recording (unabridged by default, English editions by plain title), keeps abridged and unabridged recordings together, imports into tidy author and book folders and talks to Audiobookshelf. It reads the same /config as Chaptarr, so you can switch either way, and System > Migrate brings a Readarr, Bookshelf or LazyLibrarian library over.[br][br]For hardlinks, keep downloads and the library on the same share and map one parent folder (see the README's Unraid section).

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Configuration, chaptarr.db and talearr.db. To move from Chaptarr, point this at Chaptarr's appdata folder.

Config.Name: Books
Config.Description: Ebook library (add it as an ebook root folder)

Config.Name: Audiobooks
Config.Description: Audiobook library (add it as an audiobook root folder)

Config.Name: Downloads
Config.Description: Download client's completed folder, mapped to the same path as in the download client container

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User id the app runs as (99 is Unraid's nobody)

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group id the app runs as (100 is Unraid's users)

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: File creation mask (002 keeps files group writable)
